name: docker-registry
title: Docker Registry
description: A private Docker image registry with a web UI to browse, inspect and delete images. Push with docker push <host>:5000/name:tag; for pushes over plain HTTP add the host to Docker's insecure-registries, or put it behind Traefik for HTTPS. The registry has no login of its own — keep it on the LAN or behind Authelia.
